scope: Concrete read, evidence-resolution and bounded edit primitives relevant to K/OE-0. High-level planners, shadow creative authorities, durable job workflows and generated-media variants are intentionally unavailable to the model.

eligibilitySemantics.ELIGIBLE_READ_ONLY: May be placed in a research PlannerEnvelope and executed only against frozen fixture state.
eligibilitySemantics.ELIGIBLE_PROXY_ONLY: May be planned and executed only by the isolated deterministic OE-2 surrogate; not approved for live project use by this benchmark.
eligibilitySemantics.EXCLUDED_FROM_ENVELOPE: ConstraintMaterializer removes this operator before the model call.

supportSemantics.LIVE_READ_UNCERTIFIED: A concrete read/resolver path exists, but broad production certification is not claimed.
supportSemantics.LIVE_NATIVE_RECEIPT_PARTIAL: The mutation reaches ProjectService/native receipt plumbing, but IF1 parity, proof or undo is incomplete.
supportSemantics.LIVE_MULTIWRITE_UNCERTIFIED: A concrete path exists but performs multiple or broad writes without a certified atomic graph contract.
supportSemantics.SHADOW_FILTERED_OR_FRAGMENTED: The registry or implementation explicitly marks the path shadow-filtered or architectural audits found competing form paths.
supportSemantics.NETWORK_OR_RIGHTS_DEPENDENT: The path depends on external retrieval/generation or unresolved rights/egress policy.
supportSemantics.UNSANDBOXED_GENERATED_CODE: The path generates executable composition code without the target production sandbox certification.
